common.corporationNumberRequired: The federal corporation number is required
common.corporationNumberTooltip: Number assigned by Corporations Canada when the corporation was incorporated — seven digits followed by a check digit. It appears with a hyphen on your certificate of incorporation (e.g. 1234567-8) and without one in online registries (e.g. 12345678): it is the same number, and both forms are accepted. ⚠️ Not to be confused with the Canada Revenue Agency Business Number (BN), a nine-digit tax identifier used for income tax and sales taxes.
